text:
</sub>  Add an isolating proof for the event-type filter

The new CI job asserts that only these four pull-request actions trigger dogfooding, but the planted-violation table in `docs/testing/ronda/dogfood-evidence-103.md:98-103` covers only the draft guard, job name, base-branch filter, and concurrency behavior. The live run cannot establish that an omitted action such as `edited` does not trigger the workflow. Because the repository’s review contract requires an isolating same-PR plant for every assertion added by a new CI job, add a run pair that makes an excluded action trigger with the plant and confirms that it does not trigger after restoring this filter.

AGENTS.md reference: [AGENTS.md:L45-L45](https://github.com/lhpaul/ronda/blob/22dbce2930fa738fe96f6377b3c841686d47dbe0/AGENTS.md#L45-L45)
